bindings.indirection_note: accept_guest hashes commands.run[-1], so the scale cannot ride as a trailing argument. The per-scale entry point is hashed here and re-verifies shared_action_sha256 at runtime before exec, so both files are effectively pinned.

decision_rule.0_2029_to_0_2149: MF trails Qwen by less than the quarter-to-full gain; report as a narrow captioner difference, not a corpus failure
decision_rule.comparator: c2p0 slot0 full = 0.2149 CLAP at CFG0 and 0.2605 at CFG 3.0 + fidelity negative, MusicCaps 5521 / MF25 / NoMask / seed 42 / full precision / --no_q
decision_rule.early_kill: The queue has no dependency mechanism -- ordering is lexicographic -- so the gate is enforced inside the action: with SCALE=full it reads the quarter arm's CFG0 report and exits 5 if clap_score < 0.1900. Touching /home/kojiek/exps_nvme/mf_full_coverage/PROCEED_TO_FULL_ANYWAY overrides it. This is the failure mode of 037, which was seated automatically after 036 returned a number its own contract said should cancel it, and had to be killed by hand 27k iterations in.
decision_rule.gte_0_2149: Music Flamingo matches Qwen at equal coverage and budget; the captioner question is settled in MF's favour
decision_rule.lte_0_2029: MF trails at equal coverage; the deficit is the captioner, not the corpus

hypothesis.not_controlled: the recaption is short_direct_v2 with enforcement, while the 100k slice was short_direct_v1 without it; prompt preset and coverage move together against 036/037. Against paired59k only coverage moves.
hypothesis.question: Does Music Flamingo hold up as a captioner at c2p0's full 251,599-clip scale, once coverage is no longer the confound?

what_each_prior_run_could_not_settle.036_037: trained on a 100k slice whose captions failed the corpus audit (73.17% unique, 35.48% of rows sharing a caption, 79.05% truncated at the T5 77-token window), so the deficit was unattributable to the captioner
what_each_prior_run_could_not_settle.paired59k: clean control -- same audio latents, rows, order, recipe and budget, only caption text differed -- but only over the 59,614-clip intersection, 23.7% of the corpus. Qwen won CLAP by 0.0073 (24x the seed floor) with all four AES metrics inside the floor.

hypothesis.what_this_moves: coverage only. Corpus rows go 59,614 -> 251,599 with the same captioner, prompt preset (short_direct_v2), enforcement (77-token window, max 5 attempts) and audio latents.

pairing_audit.code_change: meanaudio/data/data_setup.py now reads require_text_overlay per-dataset first, global second. A global-only flag also hits the val split, which has no overlay and would raise at startup -- which is why the guard ended up off everywhere.
pairing_audit.offline_gate: build_mf_fullcov_arm_inputs.py additionally samples 300 rows against the audio NPZ clip_id before writing bindings.json, and the action refuses to train if the unique caption rate is under 0.90 (CLAUDE.md checklist item 2).
pairing_audit.runtime_guard: require_text_overlay=true on the training split. The emitted TSV id is the c2p0 slot-suffixed id, which equals the audio NPZ clip_id, so extracted_audio.py:284 verifies audio clip_id, overlay clip_id and TSV caption sha on every row of every batch.
pairing_audit.why_this_is_new: paired59k had to leave the guard off because the MF 100k audio NPZs predate the clip_id field; its equivalent audit was offline and sampled. This closes the gap recorded in memory project_c2p0_corpus_provenance_2026_08_26.md.
